## What changed?

Link the related Issue if there is one. Keep this PR focused.

## Evidence and scope

For catalog changes, link the exact primary evidence and license notice. Explain the reverse-engineering/reimplementation/compatibility scope and any limitations. REA is optional; document its specific role only if claimed. Disclose your affiliation. For website changes, describe the behavior before and after.

## Checks

- [ ] I read CONTRIBUTING.md and did not include secrets or private data.
- [ ] Catalog descriptions do not overstate functionality, license scope or any claimed REA role.
- [ ] I ran `npm run readme` when changing catalog data and included the generated README.
- [ ] `npm test` passes.
- [ ] For UI changes, I ran browser checks or clearly explained what remains untested.

## Not verified

List author-reported behavior, untested platforms or other uncertainties. Leave this section honest rather than treating a source review as a software audit.
